name: Countdown clock races a row of ranked chips
looks: A large race-clock counts down over a checkered-flag strip, a row of competitor chips ranked beneath it, the viewer's own chip glowing with an outline and a small rising marker. As the clock ticks down across a few cuts, the chips swap position and a status banner beneath updates the gap to first place, first widening, then narrowing.
build: Clock ticks in real, unequal steps (not smoothly tweened); chips tween their x-position to their new rank on each cut (power2.inOut, 300-400ms). The viewer's chip keeps a persistent glow outline and a gently pulsing marker throughout. Status banner's colour flips red/green with its text on each cut.
sound: A tense ticking pulse under the countdown, a whoosh on each chip reorder.
prompt: Count a race clock down over a row of ranked competitor chips, the viewer's own entry glowing and marked, letting the chips visibly swap position across a few cuts as a status banner beneath updates the live gap to first place, so the standings feel like a real contest closing in.
